title: Fixed Footed Column Radiator
description: One original complete fixed footed column-radiator exterior. Five newly authored thick cast-looking sections each surround a real tall bevel-cornered opening; two full-length upper and lower headers join the thick end bands into one assembly. Four complete broad-soled feet, four header end bosses, one fixed lower valve branch/body/spindle/knob and a small capped upper vent finish the whole household heating silhouette. It is not a wall fan-coil cabinet resized or a cutaway boiler with more tubes: there is no outer appliance box, burner barrel, tube plate or simulated fire. All geometry new, three opaque constant PBR materials, metres, Z up, true grounded feet and horizontally centred envelope. One static prop, zero scenes, no room or external plumbing. Visible open column spaces are geometric openings, not a verified fluid circuit. No heating, pressure containment, water circulation, valve operation, installation, energy rating, burn protection, load or safety certification.
